reviews.title: Unable to save the new themes ,
reviews.text:
The app is good, but unfortunately, the fact that key features are disabled makes it useless! 
You can't save new themes directly to your library (My Faces) within the clock app on iPhone and access them later! 

You can’t stay on the new watch face—any notification or accidental button press takes you back to the main screen and to the old watch face, even if you’ve adjusted the settings! 

Other features that the app claims are available with a subscription (such as weather) do not work and are contingent on the user remaining subscribed to the app in order to function,

- The app does not allow you to purchase it once and keep it; instead, you must pay monthly or annually to use it!
